bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

bonuses.name: Synaptic Targeting
bonuses.text: Whenever a Deathmark would suffer a DN penalty to a Ballistic Skill Test, roll a d6. If the result is an Exalted Icon, the Deathmark ignores the DN penalty.

abilities.name: Dimensional Translocation
abilities.text: The Deathmark emerges from a hidden dimensional oubliette no closer than 10m to any Agent. All opponents of the Deathmark must make a DN 3 Initiative Test or are Ambushed.

abilities.name: Reanimation Protocols
abilities.text: When this Threat is destroyed, roll a d6. If the result is an Exalted Icon, it is resurrected with 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

abilities.name: Synaptic Headshot
abilities.text: On a Critical Hit, the Synaptic Disintegrator inflicts an additional Mortal Wound.
